title: The same security setting is configured in both endpoint security and a configuration profile

report.title: {Items.Count} security {Plural(Items.Count, 'setting is', 'settings are')} configured in more than one place

messages.businessImpact: Two consoles are configuring the same thing, so a change made in one is silently undone or contradicted by the other.
remediation: Decide which surface owns each setting, endpoint security or configuration, and remove it from the other.
